items.name: Uppsalaligan 4: Galaxy - 2026

venue.name: [Österledskyrkan](https://osterledskyrkan.se/valkommen-till-forsamlingen/hyr-vara-lokaler/)
venue.details: Enter using the staircase at the building's southern corner.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den fjärde deltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Uppsalaligan 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the fourth competition in the spring season of Uppsalaligan 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Westerville Weeknight Whimsy 2026
items.information: This competition does not include 3x3 and therefore may not be suitable for newer competitors. Please see [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) for a list of other upcoming competitions in Ohio. This competition also takes place on a **Thursday Evening**. Please plan accordingly! Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
